boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's os_spinLock.c, 0x02057014..0x02057410: 19 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. pret/pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/OS_spinLock.c defines OS_InitLock, OSi_DoLockByWord, OS_TryLockByWord, OSi_DoUnlockByWord, OS_UnlockByWord, OSi_DoTryLockByWord, OS_LockCartridge, OS_UnlockCartridge, OS_TryLockCartridge, the four card/cartridge bus helpers, OS_TryLockCard, OS_UnlockCard, OS_ReadOwnerOfLockWord, and the asm OS_UnLockCartridge, OS_GetLockID and OS_ReleaseLockID. 18 of them are here, each identified by its body as well as its size (the bus helpers by which EXMEMCNT bit they set or clear: 0x80 cartridge, 0x800 card). OS_LockCartridge is absent because nothing in this game calls it.
One extra member: OSi_WaitByLoop (0x020570a8, 0x10) calls OS_SpinWait(0x1000). The lock loops call it between retries, which is where pret's tree has an inline wait.

Order: mwccarm emits an asm function where it stands and defers the C bodies, emitting them in reverse. The three asm functions (OS_UnLockCartridge, OS_GetLockID, OS_ReleaseLockID) open the run, then the C functions come in reverse source order down to OS_InitLock at 0x02057320, the first function in the SDK file.
BOTTOM EDGE: OS_InitIrqTable at 0x02057000 is the last function of os_interrupt.c (arm9/OS_Interrupt).
TOP EDGE: OS_VSNPrintf at 0x02057410, the lowest of os_printf.c (arm9/OS_Printf).
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/MI_Memory and arm9/OS_Interrupt: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
Every symbol was renamed from its func_ name to the SDK name in this change (symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence).
Text-only: OS_InitLock's once-flag (pret's static isInitialized) stays the extern data_020a6124. The file claims no data.
OS_SpinWait (src/OS_SpinWait.c, os_system.c) and MI_SwapWord (src/MI_SwapWord.c, mi_swap.c) belong to other SDK files and stay their own sources.
